source: Curated GitHub main roadmap; official V2 statuses stay in v2/tasks/status.json. PR/task evidence reviewed 2026-11-02; assigned or unmerged work is not accepted completion.
completionPolicy: All 11 ENH entries are separate from the ten official V2 tasks; no enhancement counts toward V2 completion and no unmerged or locally tested implementation may be shown as DONE.

items.title: Evidence Explorer & detector-to-dashboard bridge
items.detail: Draft Mac dashboard PR #67 and Windows bridge PR #91 remain unmerged. Rahil reported 160/160 passes across five Windows suites in local testing, but the latest bridge/headless checks and Mac bindEvidence publication are outstanding. The prior integrated Windows performance gate was not met; no V2-007 DONE claim.
items.dependency: Publish and integrate the Mac UI evidence seam with Rahil's bridge, obtain same-SHA Mac/Windows tests, resolve performance issue #76 and complete V2-007 acceptance.

items.title: Optional real satellite mission-map preview
items.detail: Optional satellite preview remains in draft stacked PRs #72/#75/#90. Mac and Windows each reported 15/15 geographic tests and imagery/attribution/offline-denial checks; the original missing attribution and contrast issues were addressed in #75. These are synthetic route previews, not surveyed BITM flights.
items.dependency: Shabaz to review provider terms and credits, human visual interaction and stacked PR merge order (#75 into #72; #90 into #75), then accept the preview; no offline tile-redistribution permission assumed.

items.title: Innovative Mission Intelligence UI & Focus Mode
items.detail: Focus Mode, map/3-D hierarchy, accessible sensor/evidence panels and a guide-friendly layout are planned. Keep optional UI design independent of the active V2-007 code and event-inspector integration.
items.dependency: Accepted V2-007 baseline and measured Mac performance before modifying the production dashboard.

items.title: More realistic 3-D aircraft, terrain and sensor geometry
items.owner: Rahil + Codex (after V2 acceptance); Shabaz review
items.detail: Higher-fidelity quadrotor, more natural deterministic terrain and footprints/LiDAR overlays tied to actual public sensor geometry, with quality fallback.
items.dependency: Complete official V2 acceptance, assess performance issue #76, preserve sensor geometry contracts and require Mac/Windows benchmarks with a graceful fallback.

items.title: Mission replay, scenario comparison & science debrief
items.detail: V2-006 is DONE as a software deliverable but its scientific VALIDATION is negative. Replay, scenario comparison and debrief remain blocked pending V2-007 and V2-008 acceptance, with transparent false-alarm reporting.
items.dependency: Finish V2-007, then V2-008 export/replay/fault/performance acceptance. Keep this optional extension separate from the official task status.

items.title: Nested sensor-quality truth firewall hardening
items.detail: Issue #69 nested quality allowlist fix is published in draft PR #92 (reported 135/135 Mac tests); no observed producer truth leak. Mac Claude is preparing a separate stacked hardening PR for units, noise_parameters and malformed distortion. Codex audit PR #94 merged as documentation.
items.dependency: Review and merge #92 then its separately tested schema-extension PR; verify producer compatibility and Windows/bridge tests. Leave zero-valid-pixel stats mismatch separately tracked.

items.title: Mac dark/light-theme detector-demo correction
items.detail: The Mac dark/light MATLAB detector-demo readability correction from stacked PR #74 was incorporated through merged V2-006 PR #66 into main. V2-006 is officially DONE as a software task; negative VAL (G07 0/4 detected) remains unchanged.
items.dependency: Keep theme regression in subsequent UI acceptance and confirm no presentation text suggests scientifically validated detection.

items.title: BITM campus satellite demonstration mode
items.owner: Shabaz (Mac Claude after V2); Rahil geometry review; Codex supporting fallback
items.detail: Optional recognizable BITM campus imagery behind a clearly labelled simulated planned flight route, with no real-campus anomaly markers or mine/clearance inference.
items.dependency: Accepted satellite-preview PR stack, user-approved approximate WGS84 campus anchor/bounds, visible provider credits and proven independent offline ENU fallback. No real-campus anomaly markers.

items.title: Offline BITM campus backdrop and licensing verification
items.owner: Codex (isolated offline schematic), Shabaz (rights/acceptance), Rahil (optional Windows check)
items.detail: Codex has published a standalone original MATLAB schematic in draft PR #95 at a56d34ba, labelled ILLUSTRATIVE / NOT SURVEYED / SIMULATION CONTEXT. Five focused tests are authored but MATLAB was NOT run. This is not a real BITM campus map. Real imagery download, caching and redistribution remain blocked until licensing and approved bounds are documented.
items.dependency: Run exact-SHA Mac/Windows MATLAB and actual network-denied/visual checks, inspect the original schematic and record evidence; Shabaz must separately approve campus extent, imagery rights and integration. ENH-009 is not DONE.

items.title: Ballari-to-BITM location introduction for guide demo
items.owner: Codex (after ENH-009 scaffold); Shabaz (presentation); Mac Claude (later integration)
items.detail: Ballari-to-BITM intro is storyboarded but not implemented. Proposed next Codex task after an independent ENH-009 draft: offline-first schematic introduction, honest geography labels and handoff to a separate synthetic MATLAB mission.
items.dependency: Codex ENH-009 scaffold, approved campus reference and presentation rights, then optional lightweight UI integration after core V2 acceptance.

items.title: Synchronize campus satellite context with synthetic 3-D UAV
items.owner: Shabaz (Mac UI), Rahil (single-clock contracts), Codex (independent review)
items.detail: Synchronized satellite-context and 3-D virtual aircraft playback is deferred. One public MissionEngine clock/pose must drive both views, and real-world campus imagery must never display synthetic suspected hazards.
items.dependency: Official V2-007/V2-008 acceptance, issue #76 performance gate, approved campus anchor, satellite-preview rights and Mac/Windows same-clock geometry checks.
